<!-- pr-reviewer: ca11cb86040dbec7529c3088fceb3a96e1899f13 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review because the PR changes gouge verification in `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs`.

### What looks good
- `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:146-156` extracts `edge_is_wall` from `wall_gouge` so both `tangency` and `wall_gouge` share one midpoint predicate.
- `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:114-124` filters `cx.region` edges through `edge_is_wall` only when `cx.mode == Mode::Boundary` and `cx.model.is_some()`.
- All `section` edges remain checked unconditionally in `tangency`. `Mode::Area`, no-model `Mode::Boundary`, and the solid law `solid` stay unchanged.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!` appears outside tests. `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs` stays under 400 lines (396 lines).
- Unit, integration, and posting tests pin both an open outer rim with a hole lift and a wall below the model top (`crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:362`, `crates/sim/tests/boundary_walls.rs:191-250`, and `crates/app/tests/face_rim_hole.rs`).
- `docs/decisions/2657-face-rim-hole-verify.md` records the decision, the rationale, and the dropped options.
- No `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `.cargo/`, process files, UI files, snapshot PNGs, or `.cl` / `.nc` goldens changed (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty).
- The PR body includes a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2657`.

### Results (local, trial merge with `upstream/main` `75e74a9cbd8d79b36651a8e77cf41fa8c429b402`)
No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with `upstream/main` succeeded with no conflicts. `git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 13 of 13 steps passed in 23.4 min.
  - `camcraft-sim`: `lib` 191 passed; `boundary_arc_planes` 3 passed; `boundary_arc_walls` 4 passed; `boundary_walls` 6 passed; `model_excess` 6 passed.
  - `camcraft-app`: `coarse_rims` 5 passed; `face_rim_hole` 2 passed; `real_tip_contour` 4 passed; `slot_caps` 4 passed; `thread_mill_rim` 11 passed; `verify_arc_reading` 7 passed.
- Additional `camcraft-app` suites (`lib` and 9 integration suites): all active tests passed.
  - `app:lib` 380 passed (1 ignored); `blind_floor` 8 passed; `contour_outside_hole` 5 passed; `face_holes` 3 passed; `face_stock_edge` 3 passed; `solid_law` 4 passed; `solid_law_goldens` 7 passed; `verify` 21 passed (2 ignored); `wall_arc_entry` 7 passed; `warned_moves` 2 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings or errors.

### Independent mutations (local worktree, restored byte for byte)
1. Set `boundary_with_model = false` in `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:114` (matches `upstream/main`): `tangency_excuses_open_rim_with_model_and_convicts_wall_below_top`, `a_move_ending_near_an_open_outer_rim_with_a_model_is_clean`, and `face_lifting_over_a_hole_near_the_open_outer_rim_has_no_gouge_and_posts` failed (`RED`). After restore, all passed (`GREEN`).
2. Forced `edge_is_wall` to return `true` in `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:154`: `tangency_excuses_open_rim_with_model_and_convicts_wall_below_top` and `a_move_ending_near_an_open_outer_rim_with_a_model_is_clean` failed (`RED`). After restore, all passed (`GREEN`).
3. Set `section = None` in `crates/sim/src/verify/section.rs:96`: `tangency_excuses_open_rim_with_model_and_convicts_wall_below_top` failed on the wall-below-model-top assertion (`left: []`, `right: [Gouge { at: 0 }, Gouge { at: 1 }]`) (`RED`). After restore, all passed (`GREEN`).

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `edge_is_wall` probes only the edge midpoint (`WALL_PROBE = 0.05` mm). If one long `cx.region` edge has a boss at its midpoint and air at its ends, `edge_is_wall` treats the whole edge as a wall. `wall_gouge` uses this same rule. It reports a warning instead of hiding a gouge.
- The full `batch` tier, the `release` heavy lanes, and the `crates/ui` suites did not run.
- No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
